    Privacy Preference Center

    When you visit this Site, information may be stored in or retrieved from your browser using cookies or similar technologies that may be installed by us or by our suppliers and partners. This information may relate to you, your preferences or your device and may be used to operate, improve, analyze performance and maintain the security of the Site, to enable users to use the services offered on the Site and to select certain preferences, for marketing purposes and to provide you with content and advertising targeted to your interests. We may communicate the information we collect to some of our service providers (marketing, data processing, analysis, fraud detection services, professional consulting). This information may be communicated outside of Quebec and Canada.

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Strictly Necessary Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.

    Performance Cookies

    Performance cookies are important because they allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. With this data, we can analyze what you, as a visitor, are looking for and viewing on our site in order to improve it and better meet your needs.

    Functional Cookies

    These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

    Marketing Cookies

    These cookies allow advertisers to show you ads related to your interests when you visit other websites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will still see ads but they will be less relevant to you.
